panels.title: ABOUT
panels.text: **lab-arcade-shooter** is a neon geometry shooter in [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/) (2024 edition) and [Bevy](https://bevyengine.org/) 0.16. The shapes pulse. You shoot back.

items.text: Multi-stage boss fights and bullet hells in a neon arena.
One hand-written WGSL shader: scanlines, vignette, barrel distortion.
Runs native on Windows, macOS and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
Sprites are shapes. Audio is synthesized. No asset files ship with the game.
Open source under the MIT License.
[CI](https://github.com/VelimirMueller/lab-arcade-shooter/actions/workflows/ci.yml) checks format, lints and tests on every push and pull request to `main`.
Latest stable, 2024 edition. Install it from [rust-lang.org](https://www.rust-lang.org/tools/install).
With Vulkan, Metal or DirectX 12 support.

panels.title: IN THE BROWSER (WASM) · TRUNK
lines: $ trunk build --release   # output lands in dist/

items.text: The web build uses [Trunk](https://trunkrs.dev/).
The browser picks a lighter quality tier: less bloom, flat CRT.
There are no touch controls yet.
`WASM_BUILD.md` has the browser-specific fixes and pitfalls.
`Menu` > `RoundAnnounce` > `RoundActive`. Every system is gated on it.
Player, boss phases, collision, powerups.
Particles, screen shake, HUD.
Synthesized. Driven by `SoundEvent`.
Shapes + bloom, then the CRT WGSL post-process at a quality tier per platform.
A native window or a browser canvas.
Small systems, gated on `GameState`. One system does one thing.
Systems talk through events (`SoundEvent`, `DeathEvent`). Features stay independent.
The renderer draws shapes with bloom. The CRT shader runs last, at a quality tier per platform.
The same code builds native and WASM. Only the quality tier changes.

rows.text: Requires Metal support and a recent OS version.

panels.title: PROJECT STRUCTURE · THE SHADER IS THE ONLY ASSET

rows.text: Design specs and plans per feature.

items.text: Small systems gated on game states and connected by events keep features independent.
A hand-written WGSL shader (scanlines, vignette, barrel distortion) with quality tiers per platform.
`Instant::now()` panics in the browser, WebGPU is not ready everywhere, and audio needs the right decoder. Details in `WASM_BUILD.md`.
A `MinimalPlugins` app can run real boss and laser systems in `cargo test`, without a window.

readme.hero_alt: LAB ARCADE SHOOTER. Neon in, zero GC out. Rust, Bevy, ECS, WASM. Working.

code:
git clone https://github.com/VelimirMueller/lab-arcade-shooter.git
cd lab-arcade-shooter
cargo run --release

rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown
cargo install trunk
trunk build --release   # output lands in dist/
trunk serve --release   # local dev server
cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo test                # contributing
cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy -- -D warnings -A dead_code && cargo test   # exact CI command
